is_anopheles.evidence: Study investigated Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles arabiensis mosquitoes sampled from selected sites in Kenya (Page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Tested for Vgsc L1014S (kdr-east), Vgsc L1014F (kdr-west), and Ace-1 G119S (ace-1R) mutations (Page 2, Background; Page 3-4, Methods/Results).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 presents sample sizes (N) and allele frequencies (%) for L1014S and L1014F across four sites for An. arabiensis and An. gambiae. Page 4 reports Ace-1 G119S testing in 60 An. gambiae and 140 An. arabiensis specimens.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected indoors between August 2016 and November 2017 in four field sites in Kenya: Migori, Baringo, Kirinyaga, and Tana River (Page 3, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article describing original empirical data on marker genotyping and chromosomal inversions.

sub_country_location.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from specific counties in Kenya: Migori, Baringo, Kirinyaga, and Tana River (Page 3, Methods & Fig 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted between August 2016 and November 2017 (16 months duration) (Page 3, Methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Archived mosquitoes collected within the context of a malaria vector survey by KEMRI and NMCP were used, but marker genotyping data reported appears novel to this publication.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype frequency and sample size data for target markers are provided within the main text and Table 2.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated target-site resistance mutations (Vgsc L1014S, Vgsc L1014F, Ace-1 G119S) and the 2La chromosomal inversion in archived Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles arabiensis field specimens collected across four counties in Kenya between August 2016 and November 2017. Vgsc L1014S and L1014F frequencies were reported per site and species, while Ace-1 G119S was absent in all tested specimens. No phenotype bioassays were performed.
